review_text: I really tried to give Barok Coffee another chance, but sadly it still didn’t deliver. I ordered the creamy chicken pesto and it was honestly disappointing. The pasta was soggy and overcooked, and the chicken even had bones in it, which completely threw me off. It just didn’t feel well-prepared. My partner got the premium carbonara, and it was not what we were expecting at all. It was way too creamy to the point that it didn’t taste like a proper savory dish anymore. It felt heavy and more like eating a dessert than actual pasta. Not to mention their bread is stale. I also tried the Barok vanilla drink, and it tasted like plain milk with too much sugar. There wasn’t much flavor to it besides sweetness. I gave this place another shot hoping things would be better, but it ended up being the same kind of experience.
Beef nachos was nice, I liked how the toppings was served as separate dip

Love love love the Matcha Frappe here. I haven't tried their dishes though. Also the place is really small but it's good for "tambayan" late in the evening. There is only 1 service crew since the place is small but it's good, also kuya please try to smile and engage the customer a bit more. 🤍

I recently visited for a midnight dinner and was impressed! The generous serving sizes were a pleasant surprise, particularly the huge ribs. The restaurant itself was clean, with a great ambiance. Staff are also friendly. Kudos to the team!
